%CH.comment: From 50 to 75 is a rise of 50 percent

NOT.comment: Flips every bit of 5, giving -6 in two's complement

ROTXY.comment: Rotates the 8 right by 1 bit, giving 4

COMPLEX.comment: y becomes the real part and x the imaginary part: 3 + 4i

DIM?.comment: Makes a 2 by 3 matrix; DIM? puts the rows in y and the columns in x

LASTX.comment: Square root of 9 gives 3; LASTX brings back the 9 it used

R↑.comment: Stack of 1 2 3 4: the 1 from t comes to x, and the 4 moves up to y

R↓.comment: Stack of 1 2 3 4: the 4 in x goes to t, the 3 from y comes to x

FCSTX.comment: Data points (1,2) and (3,4); the line reaches y = 5 at x = 4

FCSTY.comment: Data points (1,2) and (3,4); the line gives y = 6 at x = 5

MEAN.comment: Of the points (1,2) and (3,4); x shows the mean of the x values

WMEAN.comment: The x values 1 and 3 weighted by the y values 2 and 4

CORR.comment: Each point typed as y ENTER x Σ+: (1,2), (3,4), (5,7)

Σ+.comment: Adds the point with y = 2 and x = 1; the count 1 replaces x

Σ-.comment: Removes the point added a moment ago, so the count is back to 0

→POL.comment: The point x = 3, y = 4 is 5 from the origin at 53.1301 degrees

→REC.comment: Length 2 at 30 degrees gives x = 1.7321 and y = 1
